answer: Epoch-Linked Behavioural Fingerprint Rule. Each identity’s actions per epoch are hashed into a behavioural kernel; the system compares successive kernels through a similarity prism, flagging identities whose patterns shift beyond a tolerance. Persistent divergence across epochs freezes rewards and requires re-validation. A sybil farm must sustain consistent behaviour matching its fable across many epochs, multiplying coordination and compute costs per identity.
